articles.title: Three dead after gunman opens fire at Westfield mall in Sydney
articles.description: Police said a gunman shot shoppers at the Westfield Bondi Junction mall in Sydney on Saturday before an officer shot him dead. Two more people were injured.

articles.title: Sydney mall shooting: police name Westfield gunman
articles.description: New South Wales police identified the gunman who shot shoppers at Westfield Bondi Junction in Sydney before an officer shot him. Three people died.

articles.title: Witnesses describe panic inside Westfield Bondi Junction as gunman opened fire
articles.description: Shoppers at the Sydney mall told of running for the exits when a gunman began shooting at Westfield Bondi Junction. Police said three people were killed and the attacker was shot by an officer.

articles.title: Sydney Opera House announces summer concert season
articles.description: The Sydney Opera House unveiled its summer programme of concerts and festivals on Saturday, with tickets on sale next month.

articles.title: Spanish parliament rejects government's housing decree
articles.description: Lawmakers in Madrid voted down the housing decree proposed by Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez on Tuesday, a defeat for the government's rent controls.

articles.title: Sánchez suffers defeat as Congress votes down housing decree
articles.description: The Spanish Congress rejected the government's housing decree in Madrid on Tuesday, with the opposition and separatist parties voting against the rent measures.

articles.title: Thousands march in Madrid over housing after decree defeat
articles.description: Tens of thousands protested in Madrid on Tuesday evening demanding rent controls, hours after parliament rejected the government's housing decree.

articles.title: Housing protesters fill Madrid streets after parliament vote
articles.description: Demonstrators marched through the Spanish capital calling for affordable rents after Congress voted down Pedro Sánchez's housing decree.

articles.title: Magnitude 6.1 earthquake strikes Malatya in eastern Turkey
articles.description: A magnitude 6.1 earthquake hit Malatya province in eastern Turkey on Thursday morning, damaging buildings, the AFAD disaster agency said.

articles.title: Buildings collapse as strong quake hits Turkey's Malatya
articles.description: An earthquake of magnitude 6.1 struck near Malatya in eastern Turkey, AFAD said, with several buildings damaged and rescue teams deployed to the province.

articles.title: Rescuers search rubble after Malatya earthquake kills four
articles.description: Rescue teams in Malatya searched damaged buildings after the magnitude 6.1 earthquake in eastern Turkey, AFAD said; four people died and dozens were injured.

articles.title: Russian missile strike damages major bridge in Kyiv
articles.description: A Russian missile hit the Pivnichnyi bridge across the Dnipro in Kyiv overnight, Ukrainian officials said, closing the crossing to traffic.

articles.title: Kyiv bridge closed after overnight Russian strike
articles.description: Ukraine's capital closed the Pivnichnyi bridge over the Dnipro after a Russian missile struck it overnight, city officials said; repairs will take weeks.

articles.title: Russian drone strike hits apartment block in Kharkiv, two injured
articles.description: A Russian drone struck a residential building in Kharkiv overnight, injuring two people, regional governor Oleh Syniehubov said.

articles.title: Two hurt as drones hit Kharkiv housing block overnight
articles.description: Russian drones damaged an apartment building in Kharkiv, Ukraine's second city, Syniehubov said; two residents were injured and taken to hospital.

articles.title: Hungarian novelist wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
articles.description: The Swedish Academy awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature to Hungarian novelist Ilona Varga on Thursday for her trilogy on postwar Budapest.

articles.title: Ilona Varga awarded Nobel literature prize
articles.description: The Swedish Academy named Hungarian writer Ilona Varga the winner of this year's Nobel Prize in Literature, praising her novels about Budapest.

articles.title: Nobel Peace Prize goes to Sudanese doctors' network
articles.description: The Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize to a network of volunteer doctors in Sudan for their work during the war, it announced in Oslo on Friday.

articles.title: Sudan volunteer doctors win Nobel Peace Prize
articles.description: A Sudanese network of volunteer doctors was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in Oslo for treating the wounded during the civil war, the Nobel Committee said.

articles.title: Erdoğan and Macron agree on Syria aid corridor at Ankara talks
articles.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and French President Emmanuel Macron agreed in Ankara to open a humanitarian corridor into northern Syria, the two leaders said.

articles.title: Turkey and France agree Syria humanitarian corridor after Erdogan-Macron meeting
articles.description: President Erdogan and President Macron said after talks in Ankara that Turkey and France would open an aid corridor into northern Syria within weeks.

articles.title: Trump signs order imposing 25% tariff on imported steel
articles.description: President Donald Trump signed an executive order at the White House on Monday imposing a 25 percent tariff on imported steel, citing national security.

articles.title: Trump imposes 25% steel tariff by executive order
articles.description: The White House said President Trump signed an order placing a 25 percent tariff on steel imports on Monday, drawing protests from trading partners.

articles.title: Trump says Fed chair should resign at Ohio rally
articles.description: President Donald Trump told supporters at a rally in Ohio on Tuesday that the Federal Reserve chair should resign over interest rates.

articles.title: Trump threatens tariffs on European cars in rally speech
articles.description: President Trump said at a rally in Ohio that he would impose tariffs on European cars if the EU did not lower its own duties on American goods.

articles.title: Inmate survives botched execution in Alabama, hospitalised in critical condition
articles.description: An Alabama inmate survived a botched lethal injection on Thursday night and was taken to hospital in critical condition, the corrections department said.

articles.title: Alabama inmate in critical condition after failed execution
articles.description: Doctors are treating an Alabama prisoner who survived a failed lethal injection; the corrections department said the execution was halted after two hours.

articles.title: Alabama corrections commissioner resigns after botched execution
articles.description: The head of Alabama's corrections department resigned on Friday, a day after an inmate survived a botched lethal injection and was hospitalised.

articles.title: Commissioner steps down over failed Alabama execution
articles.description: Alabama's prisons commissioner stepped down after the failed execution of an inmate who survived the lethal injection, the governor's office said.

articles.title: Hurricane Delia makes landfall in Florida Panhandle as Category 3 storm
articles.description: Hurricane Delia came ashore near Apalachicola in the Florida Panhandle on Wednesday with 120 mph winds, the National Hurricane Center said, knocking out power to hundreds of thousands of homes.

articles.title: Delia leaves hundreds of thousands without power after Florida landfall
articles.description: Crews worked to restore electricity across the Florida Panhandle after Hurricane Delia made landfall near Apalachicola as a Category 3 storm, the National Hurricane Center said.

articles.title: Iraq and Turkey sign oil pipeline supply agreement in Ankara
articles.description: Iraq and Turkey signed an agreement in Ankara on Monday to resume crude oil exports through the Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline, the two energy ministries said.

articles.title: Baghdad and Ankara agree to restart Kirkuk-Ceyhan oil exports
articles.description: Iraq's oil ministry and Turkey's energy ministry signed a deal in Ankara to restart crude shipments through the Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline after a two-year halt.

articles.title: Drone attack sets fire to Kirkuk oil field a day after pipeline deal
articles.description: A drone strike set fire to storage tanks at an oil field in Kirkuk on Tuesday, a day after Iraq and Turkey agreed to resume exports through the Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline, officials said.

articles.title: Fire at Kirkuk oil field after drone strike
articles.description: Iraqi firefighters battled a blaze at a Kirkuk oil field after a drone attack hit storage tanks, the oil ministry said; exports were not affected.

articles.title: Tens of thousands rally in Belgrade against government on Saturday
articles.description: Tens of thousands marched through Belgrade on Saturday demanding early elections, the largest protest since the station canopy collapse.

articles.title: Huge anti-government protest fills Belgrade streets
articles.description: Serbian protesters filled central Belgrade on Saturday calling for early elections, in the biggest demonstration in months.

articles.title: Students block Belgrade bridges in second day of protests
articles.description: Student protesters blocked three bridges in Belgrade on Sunday, a day after tens of thousands rallied against the government.

articles.title: Supreme Court strikes down state social media age law
articles.description: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled 6-3 on Wednesday that a Texas law requiring age verification for social media accounts violates the First Amendment.

articles.title: Supreme Court rules Texas social media age-verification law unconstitutional
Siemens to cut 5,000 jobs in energy division
articles.description: Siemens said on Thursday it would cut 5,000 jobs in its energy business over two years as part of a restructuring announced in Munich.

articles.title: Siemens announces 5,000 job cuts at energy unit
articles.description: The German industrial group Siemens will eliminate 5,000 positions in its energy unit, the company said in Munich, citing weak demand.

articles.title: Siemens wins €2bn rail contract in Egypt
articles.description: Siemens signed a €2 billion contract on Thursday to supply trains for Egypt's new high-speed rail line, the company said.

articles.title: Judge blocks federal ban on gas stoves in new homes
articles.description: A federal judge in Washington on Monday blocked a rule banning gas stoves in newly built homes, finding the agency exceeded its authority.

articles.title: Federal court halts gas stove ban for new housing
articles.description: A U.S. district judge in Washington halted the government's ban on gas stoves in new homes on Monday, ruling the energy department overstepped.

articles.title: Administration appeals ruling that blocked gas stove ban
articles.description: The Justice Department filed an appeal on Tuesday against the Washington judge's order blocking the ban on gas stoves in new homes.

articles.title: Zelensky says Ukraine ready for ceasefire talks in Riyadh
articles.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday that Ukraine was ready to join ceasefire talks hosted by Saudi Arabia in Riyadh next week.

articles.title: Ukraine ready for Riyadh ceasefire talks, Zelensky says
articles.description: Zelensky told reporters in Kyiv that Ukrainian negotiators would travel to Riyadh for ceasefire talks hosted by Saudi Arabia.

articles.title: Zelensky orders mobilisation of 50,000 more troops
articles.description: President Zelensky signed a decree on Friday mobilising 50,000 additional soldiers, his office said, as Russian attacks continued in the east.

articles.title: Rotterdam dockworkers to strike on December 20, union says
articles.description: The FNV union said dockworkers at the port of Rotterdam would walk out on December 20 over pay, halting container traffic at Europe's largest port.

articles.title: Rotterdam port faces 20 December walkout as pay talks fail
articles.description: Dock workers in Rotterdam will strike on 20 December after pay talks with port employers collapsed, the FNV union said.

articles.title: Rotterdam union calls second port strike for December 27
articles.description: The FNV union said it would call a second strike at the port of Rotterdam on December 27 if employers do not improve their pay offer.
